name: cli-session-lifecycle-guards
body: The session lifecycle guards: the checks that keep the session the exclusive owner of the worktree database. `rust.apg.scan.cmd_scan` and `rust.apg.project_cmd.merge.project_merge_at` refuse while a session is live so the caller saves and ends first. The content-identity freshness predicate `rust.apg.git.state.is_fresh` and the shared freshness fast path in `rust.apg.pipeline.run_pipeline` consult the session socket, so a socket that is present but fails a connect plus Ping is detected as an unclean exit and the derived index is discarded and rebuilt from `apg/layers/**` ahead of a scan.
